# Apache Ossie example files

Copied unchanged, with their Apache License headers, from
[github.com/apache/ossie](https://github.com/apache/ossie) `examples/` at commit
`aedf08651451306896d98e17657c16c99848ef78` (2026-11-25), draft version `0.3.0.dev0`.
They are licensed to the Apache Software Foundation under the Apache License 2.0.

`tests/ossie.rs` imports each one and checks the entities and metrics that come out.
